s: We look again at the words from the last three days.
Let us start in the bedroom.
In my bedroom, I have a small bedside table.
What is on your bedside table?
My bedside lamp is on the bedside table.
I read with my bedside lamp at night.
My bedside lamp is old, but I love my bedside lamp.
And I put my book on my bedside table every night.
My bathroom is next to my bedroom.
I clean my bathroom every week.
What do you do in the basement?
I keep old boxes in the basement.
My basement is full of old toys.
I do not go to the basement often.

Let us talk about your day.
What do you do in the morning?
My alarm clock rings at seven.
I hate my alarm clock, but I need my alarm clock.
I put paper in the bin.
Please put the paper in the bin.
Yes, the bin in the bedroom.
And please wash your hands in the basin in the bathroom.
I like to read in my comfy armchair.
Never mind, that is a secret!
Lena, tell me about the film you watched.
I am watching an action film.
I love action films with my friends.
We can watch an action film together this weekend.
Let us watch an action film on Saturday.
He finished second in the race.
That was a very exciting film.
Wait, he finished second in the race?
He finished second in the race.
Very exciting, like an action film.
I need to go to the bank today.
The bank is near my house.
I go to the bank on Mondays.
I will fly to see my family.
We will fly to Paris next week.
I want to fly with you!
